objects.description: [NOKKI](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0353) is written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\MicroSoft Updatea\svServiceUpdate.exe prior being executed in a new process in an apparent attempt to masquerade as a legitimate folder and file.(Citation: Unit 42 NOKKI Sept 2018)
